description: This Java class 'SQLBuilder' provides utility methods to construct SQL WHERE clauses safely, preventing SQL injection by using parameterized queries. It manages criteria, arguments, and logical operators, and supports nested sub-operations.

classes.name: SQLBuilder
classes.description: Utility class for building SQL WHERE clauses with parameter binding, supporting criteria addition, nested operations, and logical operators.

classes.name: WhereLogicalOperator
classes.description: Enum defining logical operators (NONE, AND, OR) with their SQL string representations.

methods.name: addCriteria
methods.description: Adds a criteria with specified operator and logical connector to the SQL WHERE clause, validating input syntax.

methods.name: addCriteria (overload)
methods.description: Adds a criteria with default AND operator.

methods.name: addNonNullCriteria
methods.description: Adds criteria only if the argument is not null.

methods.name: addSubOperation
methods.description: Adds a nested sub-operation (grouped criteria) to the WHERE clause.

methods.name: getSQLTemplate
methods.description: Returns the constructed SQL WHERE clause with placeholders.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Returns the list of arguments corresponding to the placeholders.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a debug string representation of the current SQLBuilder state.
